<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $color,
        public ?string $maybeColor,
        public ?string $nested,
        public ?string $oneOfConst,
        public string $mixedConst,
        public ?string $objConst,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            color: $data['color'],
            maybeColor: $data['maybeColor'],
            nested: $data['nested'],
            oneOfConst: $data['oneOfConst'],
            mixedConst: $data['mixedConst'],
            objConst: $data['objConst'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'color' => $this->color,
            'maybeColor' => $this->maybeColor,
            'nested' => $this->nested,
            'oneOfConst' => $this->oneOfConst,
            'mixedConst' => $this->mixedConst,
            'objConst' => $this->objConst,
        ];
    }
}
